name: Mythic Love: Shadow Prince
source:
What if the safest place in the world... was inside a monster's prison?

One minute you're at art school, stuck on a group project with your strangest classmate. The next, a magic mishap throws you centuries into the past, and you wake up tied up in a cell.

Your captor? A monster from the Basque mythology. Tall, dark, annoyingly handsome, and absolutely convinced you're a spy. He has sealed himself inside his fortress behind a spell no one can break... so how exactly did you get in?

You, on the other hand, are pretty sure this is the most immersive escape room ever made. Great actor, too.

Survive his interrogations, escape your cell, sneak around his fortress and flirt your way past the most feared legend in the land. Because the monster everyone warns you about might be the only one who can keep you safe.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5518350/Mythic_Love_Shadow_Prince/]Steam[/url]]
